scope: Post-I0 Harness authority, release-line, consumer, and remaining-evidence observation for the Computing Ready Frontier

observations.claim: The current local Harness line contains the C3 Agent-first API and A0/U1 changes in one history; its current verified integration receipt reports 369 passing unit tests with three skips, wheel smoke, documentation, dependency, and evidence gates, and no production cutover.

ordivon_harness.api is the recommended Host-free Agent application facade, ordivon_harness.core is the wider Host-free integration surface, and historical Host-backed application behavior is explicit in ordivon_harness.host_api.
The active optional Host integration and development graph pin Host 428a6f2f90b4050535507c9be078c450552177e5.
The retained I0 acceptance explicitly leaves the independent durable real-model Runtime end-to-end path unproven and makes no Provider capability claim.

Security already exercises a materially different real DeepSeek Flash CAGE workload through Harness and documents Host- and Runtime-backed variants, so Harness has a real second workload beyond repository repair.

Security declares no base Harness dependency while dynamically importing ordivon_harness.domain_tools, ordivon_harness.ordivon.deepseek, ordivon_harness.version, and additional package-root/internal Harness surfaces; the real consumer therefore does not yet validate the C3 public package boundary.

conclusion: Source-line divergence is closed. The next Harness authority gates are real-consumer public-package adoption and one real-model independent durable Harness-to-Runtime canary before any canonical writer or production state-root decision. Observation infrastructure is not the blocker.
